_comment: Cross-implementation known-answer vector for the invite-pickup crypto (see docs/invite-pickup-flow.md sections 3.3 and 3.6). An identical copy is committed in capy-cli (tests/fixtures/inviteCrossImplementation.json) and keep-app (tests/fixtures/inviteCrossImplementation.json) -- do not edit one without the other; the two files must stay byte-identical, which is what makes this a cross-implementation pin rather than two tests that coincidentally agree. This vector pins three things: the invite-id derivation from t_hex, the pickup KEK derived from prf_output_hex/prf_salt_hex, and a wrapped_t produced by one implementation's real production wrap function and decrypted by the other's independent implementation. wrapped_t_b64/iv_b64 were produced ONCE by keep-app's real production wrapPickup() (src/lib/flow/redeemInviteCrypto.ts) on the fixed inputs below and pinned here verbatim (the iv was whatever wrapPickup's own crypto.getRandomValues happened to generate that run -- not chosen). capy-cli's cross-impl test decrypts these exact bytes with its own independent node:crypto implementation and asserts it recovers t_hex byte-for-byte.
